query.content: What function computes the winsorized mean of a numeric array by replacing the lowest and highest 10% of observations with the nearest retained boundary values, suitable for robust central-tendency analysis of outlier-sensitive stock returns, and returns the result as a percentage rounded to two decimal places?

def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    stock_returns = [
        15.4, -6.2, 7.8, -14.3, 12.0, -9.1, 18.5, 25.7, -5.0, 3.3,
        21.2, -7.6, 11.7, 29.8, -19.4, 8.9, 4.5, -11.2, 6.6, -13.7
    ]
    winsor_percent = 0.10

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    sorted_returns = sorted(stock_returns)
    n = int(len(sorted_returns) * winsor_percent)

    winsorized_returns = sorted_returns[:]
    lower_value = sorted_returns[n]
    upper_value = sorted_returns[-n - 1]

    for i in range(n):
        winsorized_returns[i] = lower_value
        winsorized_returns[-i - 1] = upper_value

    winsorized_mean = sum(winsorized_returns) / len(winsorized_returns)
    answer = round(winsorized_mean, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
